 Dated this the 8th day of November, 2024
ORDER The petitioners have filed the application under Section 438 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 for an order of pre-arrest bail.

2. The petitioners apprehend arrest in Crime No. 18 of 2024 registered by the Mahila Thana West Jodhpur Police Station, Rajasthan, for allegedly committing offences under Sections 498A, 306 and 323 of Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: 3. Whether the application came up for consideration on 07.02.2024, this Court directed the petitioners to take steps to implead the defacto complainant as additional respondent.
Even after the lapse of more than 8 months, no steps have been taken.
It is 2024:KER:83622 BAIL APPL. NO. 900 OF 2024 assumed that the petitioners are no longer desirous of prosecuting the bail application.
Resultantly, the bail application is dismissed for default, without prejudice to the right of the petitioners to workout their remedies in accordance with law.
